name: fld_pow_bijective_iff_coprime
statement: (K : Type) [Field K] [Fintype K] (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) : Function.Bijective (fun x : K => x ^ k) ↔ Nat.Coprime k (Fintype.card K - 1)
closed: ∀ (K : Type) [Field K] [Fintype K] (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k), Function.Bijective (fun x : K => x ^ k) ↔ Nat.Coprime k (Fintype.card K - 1)
informal: For k > 0 the power map x ↦ x^k is a permutation of F_q iff gcd(k, q-1) = 1 — it fixes 0 and on the cyclic group of units of order q-1 the k-th power map is injective iff gcd(k, q-1) = 1 (if d = gcd > 1 there is an element of order d in the kernel; conversely use Bezout u*k ≡ 1 mod q-1).
type: ∀ (K : Type) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Fintype K] (k : ℕ), 0 < k → ((Function.Bijective fun x => x ^ k) ↔ k.Coprime (Fintype.card K - 1))
